title: Heading hierarchy
description: Design an understandable reading outline with real headings and section nesting, without using text size or styling as a substitute for semantics.
objectives: Distinguish heading levels from visual font sizes
Write a logical page title, section headings and subsections
Use IDs and section labels to connect structure meaningfully
Inspect heading navigation and avoid empty or misleading headings
rubric: I wrote a meaningful page title and two logical major sections.
I inspected the heading outline and connected section labels to actual headings.
I passed heading order and section-label tests.
